description: This file defines a RatesService class for fetching and converting currency exchange rates, including a stub provider with static rates, and utility functions for currency conversion and rate retrieval.

classes.name: StubRatesProvider
classes.description: A stub implementation providing static exchange rates relative to USD.

methods.name: getPopularCurrencies
methods.description: Returns a list of popular currencies for UI selection.

methods.name: _getRatesCached
methods.description: Fetches and caches exchange rates, using cache if recent.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts an amount from one currency to another using cached rates.

methods.name: getRatesForPairs
methods.description: Retrieves exchange rates for specified currency pairs.
